description: This Java class implements a service for handling rule engine call requests, managing request timeouts, and processing responses within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultRuleEngineCallService
classes.description: Implements rule engine call handling, including request processing, timeout scheduling, and response handling.

methods.name: DefaultRuleEngineCallService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with cluster service dependency.

methods.name: initExecutor
methods.description: Initializes the scheduled executor for handling request timeouts.

methods.name: shutdownExecutor
methods.description: Shuts down the executor service during cleanup.

methods.name: processRestApiCallToRuleEngine
methods.description: Handles incoming REST API calls to the rule engine, stores response consumers, and schedules timeout.

methods.name: onQueueMsg
methods.description: Processes responses received from the rule engine, invoking the appropriate consumer.

methods.name: sendRequestToRuleEngine
methods.description: Sends a message to the rule engine via cluster service.

methods.name: scheduleTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout task for a request, invoking consumer with null if timeout occurs.
